item.title: White House, GOP leaders sway votes for rule on spending bill
item.description: Rep. Anna Paulina Luna, R-Fla. is pushing for voter ID legislation as the price for her vote on a spending package. (Tom Williams/CQ Roll Call)

item.title: King-Hinds on long commutes and the ‘tyranny of distance’
item.description: Del. Kimberlyn King-Hinds leaves a House Republican’s caucus meeting in the Capitol on Jan. 14. “I came here with the assumption that people would be a lot more knowledgeable, given the fact that everybody’s talking about China and geopolitics,” she says as she reflects on her first year in Congress.

item.title: Trump signs major spending package while immigration talks continue
item.description: Speaker Mike Johnson, R-La., speaks to reporters as he leaves the House floor following the close vote on the rule for the government funding bill in the Capitol on Tuesday.

item.title: House panel sets Bill and Hillary Clinton depositions for this month
item.description: Chairman Rep. James R. Comer, R-Ky., second from right, flanked by Rep. Scott Perry, R-Pa., Rep. Tim Burchett, R-Tenn., and Rep. Andy Biggs, R-Ariz., speaks to reporters after former Secretary of State Hillary Clinton did not appear for her deposition before the House Oversight and Government Reform Committee last month.

item.title: Senate panel delays action on satellite licensing bill
item.description: Senate Commerce Chair. Ted Cruz, R-Texas, is seen in the Capitol on Jan. 29. His bill would set time limits on FCC review of satellite proposals. (Tom Williams/CQ Roll Call)

item.title: Trump borrowing from past presidents he has long lambasted
item.description: President Donald Trump speaks to reporters Saturday aboard Air Force One after attending the Alfalfa Club's annual dinner in Washington.

item.title: Congress turns to Homeland Security funding clash
item.description: Rep. Adriano Espaillat, chair of the Congressional Hispanic Caucus, and Nydia Velazquez, D-N.Y., conduct a rally Tuesday with members of the CHC, Congressional Black Caucus, Congressional Asian Pacific American Caucus, and other caucuses, to call for the firing of Homeland Security Secretary Kristi Noem, outside Immigration and Customs Enforcement headquarters.

item.title: Top Republicans throw cold water on ‘nationalizing’ elections
item.description: Senate Majority Leader John Thune and Senate Rules and Administration Chair Mitch McConnell are facing pressure to advance a voter ID bill.

item.title: Money isn’t enough to save incumbents in wave elections
item.description: The U.S. Capitol dome is seen Tuesday over snow and ice piled near the Capitol Reflecting Pool more than a week after a storm passed over the area. (Tom Williams/CQ Roll Call)
